format.file: {format, spec, cases: [case]}; every case runs on its own, from an empty engine, with risk on.
format.case: C2's case (c2_position_cases.json FORMAT: name, why, clock, dev_bounds, groups, labels, tokens, pools, events, cost_scenario, expect_ops) plus risk. groups names each group's risk file: risk-K3.yaml, risk-H.yaml.
format.risk: group name -> [[at, text], ...]: the first item's at is null, the text the run starts with; each later item replaces the file's text when the feed hands out its first event with slot >= at, before that event (the engine has not ended the slot before it yet). A null text is a missing file. Several items with the same at apply in the order given, the groups in the order of this object.

cases.name: at_entry_the_file_is_read_again
cases.why: P1 triggers at t (entry t + 2); K3's file turns the kill switch on at t + 2 (the feed's event there comes before the slot t is ended): P1's order and its N2 order are 'at entry: kill switch'. The file is valid again from t + 300 (reloaded at the minute that starts before t + 470). P1 triggers again at t + 500: busy was set to t at the skipped entry, so it enters and fills. P2 triggers at t + 600 and its file loses size_sol at its entry slot: 'at entry: risk config invalid: …'. A flip lands before the engine ends the slot before it, so t, t + 600 and the slots before them (the inflow buys) share a minute: no minute's reload reads the new text before the signal.
